answer: Sybil resistance comes from stake-weighted identity: every agent locks a bond that is slashed if one operator is found running duplicate keys. The mechanism works by making each vote cost capital, an attacker who wants to sway the reef of voters must fund a separate sable bond for every forged identity, and linked-account detection raises the horizon of potential loss well beyond any single vote reward. Since splitting one identity into many multiplies the required stake while rewards stay shared, forgery costs far more than honest participation, so the economy deters Sybils on its own.
